title: OmniPrep™ For High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction From Mouse Tail Tissue
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6ebhbe
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare tissue in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 0.5–1 cm (≈50–100 mg) mouse tail to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 500 µL Genomic Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Digest with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Proteinase K solution, invert briefly, then incubate at 60 °C for 3–4 hours (or up to overnight), inverting the tube periodically if possible.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL chloroform and mix by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Phase separation by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 14,000 × g, then carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add DNA Stripping Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNA Stripping Solution to the aqueous phase and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Heat incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5–10 minutes at 60 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate with precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Precipitation Solution, invert several times to mix; a white precipitate should appear—if not, add 50 µL additional aliquots of Precipitation Solution until a white precipitate forms.

steps.title: Isopropanol DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µL isopropanol, and invert the tube 10 times to precipitate the genomic DNA. OPTIONAL: add 2 µL Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier for increased recovery.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 minutes, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL 70 % ethanol, invert several times to wash the DNA pellet, centrifuge for 1 minute at 14,000 × g, then decant or pipette off the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to allow excess ethanol to drain; avoid letting the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE Buffer to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate (incubation at 55–60 °C will speed rehydration; total incubation 5–60 minutes). OPTIONAL: add 1 µL LongLife™ RNase per 100 µL TE Buffer at this stage.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term use; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield is 70–80 µg per cm of tail.
